lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A massive fallen tree blocks the path ahead. The wood is thick and heavy.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: With great effort, the tree is pushed aside! You find a pouch of gold underneath.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The tree won't budge. Your party is bruised from the effort.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You take a longer path through the brush. It costs extra supplies but you arrive safely.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You'll have to go the long way around. The detour costs extra supplies.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: While searching, you find some supplies someone stashed nearby. Useful!
